# Phase 7 tables (generated by src/run_phase7_mechanism.py)

Pre-registered in docs/phase7_preregistration.md. Spreads are long-short; the market is the equal-weighted Nifty 50 benchmark of the same universe minus the T-bill rate. Newey-West with 3 lags. Bootstrap: month-block stationary bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20100101, betas re-estimated in every resample. H1 and H2 here come from the same joint month-block resamples as H3, so their intervals differ slightly from the separate Phase 4 / Phase 6 H1 and H2 bootstraps.

Reproduction check (raw H3, V2, Method A, against Phase 6): 20/20 rows identical.
